description: Tags of the mboll.eu Telegram threat-intelligence feed: bot-token liveness, relay infrastructure and data provenance.

predicates.description: Result of the latest daily getMe check. On a token attribute: status of exactly this token. On an event: 'alive' if at least one token of the bot is alive, otherwise 'dead'.
Infrastructure the malware uses instead of calling api.telegram.org directly.
Whether a network indicator is specific to the operator or a shared/generic service.
How widely the bot token is used across samples.

entry.description: Token: Telegram accepted this token at the latest check. Event: at least one token of the bot is alive.
Token: Telegram rejected this token (HTTP 401/404) at the latest check. Event: all tokens of the bot are dead.
Not checked yet or the last check failed.
A *.workers.dev host proxying requests to the Telegram Bot API.
Extracted from URLs contacted by the sample in VirusTotal sandboxes.
Retrieved live from the Telegram Bot API with the observed token (getMe, getChat, ...).
Infrastructure that belongs to the operator; suitable for detection.
A generic service (webhook relays, bot builders); do not block on it.
Many samples across several malware families use this token; likely a builder default or leaked token used by independent actors. Do not attribute on this bot alone.
